senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חפף I)to cover, spread over.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:7">Ḥull. III, 7</cite> <he>וכנפיו חוֹפִין וכ׳</he> and whose wings cover the largest portion of its body.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 9:15">Sot. IX, 15</cite> (<cite ref="Sotah 49a:17">49ᵃ</cite>) <he>וחָפוּ ראשם</he> and covered their heads (in shame).—Part. pass. <he>חָפוּי</he>.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 10:6">Esth. R. to VI, 12</cite> <he>וחֲפוּי ראש וכ׳</he> and his head covered (in shame) over what had happened to him; <cite ref="Megillah 16a">Meg. 16ᵃ</cite>
<cite ref="Yoma 47a:19">Yoma 47ᵃ</cite> <he>חוֹפֶה שלש וכ׳</he> he bends three of his fingers (grasping with them) up to &c.; cmp. <cite ref="H01458"><he>חָפַן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Kilaim 1:15">Tosef. Kil. I, 15</cite> <he>המְחַפֶּה</he> who covers up (mixed seeds with earth); <cite ref="Moed Katan 2b">M. Kat. 2ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Makkot 21b">Macc. 21ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Makkot 21b:4">Ib.</cite> <he>החופה</he> ed. (Ms. M. <he>המח׳</he>). Y. Kil. VII, 31ᵇ <he>לא במחפה</he> is it not because in plowing over he covers the seeds up? <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 4:5">Shebi. IV, 5</cite> <he>לא יְהַפֵּהוּ בעפר</he> he must not cover it (the cut) with loose ground, opp. to (<cite ref="K00915"><he>כסה</he></cite>) covering with stones. Y. Taan. II, beg. 65ᵃ <he>אבותינו חִיפּוּ … חִיפִּינוּ וכ׳</he> our ancestors covered it (the reader’s desk) with gold, and we with dust.
<cite ref="Niddah 16a">Nidd. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>ותְחַפֶּנָּהּ וכ׳</he> and semen virile may have covered it up; a. e.

senses.gloss: to cover over, to protect from justice, to be partial.
units: <cite ref="Shevuot 39a:19">Shebu. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>מפני שמְחַפִּין עליו</he> because they (the publican’s or robber’s relations) protect him.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30">Ex. R. s. 30</cite> <he>היו מְחַפִּין אותו</he> tried to protect him; a. e.

senses.gloss: (cmp. גָּבַב) [to heap up words,] to invent fictions (v.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 94">Gen. R. s. 94</cite> (play on <he>הפים</he>, <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 46:21">ib. XLVI, 21</cite>) <he>שחִיפּוּ עליו דברים וכ׳</he> about whom they invented a fiction (<cite ref="Genesis 37:3">Gen. XXXVII, 3</cite>).
